sloka: शोकस्सम्धार्यताम् मातर्हृदये साधु मा शुचः ।वनवासादिहैष्यामि पुनः कृत्वा पितुर्वचः ॥२-२१-४७॥
transliteration: śokassamdhāryatām mātarhṛdaye sādhu mā śucaḥ ।vanavāsādihaiṣyāmi punaḥ kṛtvā piturvacaḥ ॥2-21-47॥

translations.english: Do not grieve, O mother Be prudent enough to subdue your sorrow in your heart. Having fulfilled father's words, I shall come back from my sojourn in the forest.
